title: astragalus hamosus subsp. brachyceras
intro: Astragalus hamosus subsp. brachyceras, commonly known as a type of legume, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus hamosus subsp. brachyceras are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
